verdict.rationale: INPI offers the free Start INPI app, which guides users through each step of a formality with tutorials and videos. The dépôt d'actes page also explains in practical, non-statutory language how to pay, sign (including the FranceConnect+ alternative), anonymise documents and track progress ('cliquez sur « Suivre l'avancement du dépôt d'actes »'). Missing for 10: no evidence that guidance covers every formality type (creation, modification, cessation), no hands-on or independent confirmation that a non-lawyer can actually follow it, and no detail on the tutorials' content.
